success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空加速实际用攻即触发，面板速度60%附粉不计能力等级，MISS/整招无效仍执行，控制属性药剂不执行',()=>{for(const level of[-6,0,6]){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,aStats:{spe:500}});s.fighters[0].stages.spe=level;turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.windows.length,1);}for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','status','potion']){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='status'?29251:mode==='potion'?null:10361);const n=mode==='miss'||mode==='invalid'?300:0;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050?.windows.length??0,n?1:0);}});
